description: A shell script for managing external toolchain tasks, including testing compiler features, finding libraries and binaries, generating configuration files, and creating wrapper scripts for cross-compilation toolchains.

methods.name: test_c
methods.description: Tests C compiler functionality by compiling a simple 'Hello, world!' program.

methods.name: test_cxx
methods.description: Tests C++ compiler functionality by compiling a simple 'Hello, world!' program.

methods.name: test_softfloat
methods.description: Tests soft-float support in the compiler.

methods.name: test_feature
methods.description: Checks for specific compiler and libc features such as 'c', 'c++', 'softfloat', 'lfs', 'ipv6', 'rpc', 'locale', 'wchar', and 'threads'.

methods.name: print_config
methods.description: Generates a .config file for a specified target based on the current toolchain.

methods.name: probe_cc
methods.description: Finds the C compiler in the toolchain directories.

methods.name: probe_cxx
methods.description: Finds the C++ compiler in the toolchain directories.

methods.name: probe_cpp
methods.description: Finds the C preprocessor in the toolchain directories.

methods.name: probe_libc
methods.description: Determines whether the libc is uClibc or glibc.

methods.name: find_libs
methods.description: Finds shared library files matching specified patterns for a given library type.

methods.name: find_bins
methods.description: Finds binary executable files matching specified patterns for a given program.

methods.name: wrap_bin_cc
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script for the C compiler.

methods.name: wrap_bin_ld
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script for the linker.

methods.name: wrap_bin_other
methods.description: Creates a generic wrapper script for other executables.
